title: Sheep in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- fluffy body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="24" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="52" r="13" fill="#efe8dc"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="52" r="13" fill="#efe8dc"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="70" r="12" fill="#efe8dc"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="70" r="12" fill="#efe8dc"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="13" fill="#f8f4ee"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="42" r="10" fill="#f3eee4"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="42" r="10" fill="#f3eee4"/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="38" y="78" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#6b5f58"/>
  <rect x="56" y="78" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#6b5f58"/>
  <rect x="38" y="86" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3f3a36"/>
  <rect x="55" y="86" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3f3a36"/>

  <!-- scarf wrap -->
  <path d="M32 48 Q50 56 68 48 L68 56 Q50 64 32 56 Z" fill="#e84545"/>
  <path d="M32 48 Q50 56 68 48 L68 51 Q50 59 32 51 Z" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d="M64 55 Q70 62 66 72 Q64 76 60 74 Q62 66 60 58 Z" fill="#e84545"/>
  <path d="M65 57 Q69 63 66 70 Q64 72 62 71 Q64 65 63 59 Z" fill="#ff8a8a"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#e8dfd2"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="30" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#d4c8b8" transform="rotate(-20 33 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="30" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#d4c8b8" transform="rotate(20 67 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="30" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#f5c6c6" transform="rotate(-20 33 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="30" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#f5c6c6" transform="rotate(20 67 30)"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="33" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#2a2a3a"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="33" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#2a2a3a"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="32" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="32" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- nose & mouth -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#c99a8a"/>
  <path d="M47 43 Q50 46 53 43" stroke="#a88070" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="38" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#f5b0b0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="61" cy="38" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#f5b0b0" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- top fluff -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="20" r="6" fill="#faf6f0"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="20" r="6" fill="#faf6f0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="17" r="5" fill="#fdfaf5"/>
</svg>
